title: Start Antigravity (AGY) CLI / IDE
description: Launches the Google Antigravity agentic coding assistant and IDE interface in the Kali Linux terminal.

title: Check Antigravity Status & Version
description: Quickly inspects the installed Antigravity CLI version and active background agent/workspace status.

title: Nmap Comprehensive Stealth SYN Scan
description: Executes a full TCP port scan (1-65535) with service version detection, default NSE scripts, OS fingerprinting, and output saved to a text file.

title: Netcat Reverse Shell Listener
description: Sets up a local TCP listener to capture incoming reverse shells on the specified port.

title: List All Listening Ports & Associated PIDs
description: Displays all active TCP and UDP listening sockets along with process names and PIDs. Essential for detecting rogue listeners.

title: Gobuster Web Directory Enumeration
description: Fast multi-threaded directory and file discovery for target web applications including specific file extensions.

title: Find SUID Binaries (Linux PrivEsc Check)
description: Scans the entire filesystem for executable files with the SUID bit set, helping identify privilege escalation vectors.

title: TShark Live Packet Capture (Filter HTTP/HTTPS)
command: sudo tshark -i <interface> -f "tcp port 80 or tcp port 443" -w capture_<interface>.pcap
description: CLI packet capture using Wireshark's TShark utility targeting HTTP and HTTPS traffic on a chosen interface.

title: Quick Python 3 HTTP Server
description: Spins up an ad-hoc web server in the current working directory to easily transfer files across local lab systems.

title: Inspect UFW Firewall Rules with Index Numbers
description: Shows current Uncomplicated Firewall state and indexed rule ordering, essential prior to deleting or inserting rules.

title: Analyze Failed SSH Login Attempts
command: grep "Failed password" /var/log/auth.log | awk '{print $(NF-3)}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -20
description: Parses authentication log for failed SSH authentication attempts, groups by attacking source IP, and outputs the top 20 offenders.

title: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) - Core Tenets
command:
# Concept: Never trust, always verify.
# 1. All data sources and computing services are resources.
# 2. All communication is secured regardless of network location.
# 3. Access is granted on a per-session basis.
# 4. Access is determined by dynamic policy.
description: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust summary: assumes breach and verifies each request as though it originated from an uncontrolled network.

command:
